# Fawley Bridge Primary School - site workspace

Working area for the school office.

- duties/  the post accountable for each recurring duty

Each recurring duty sits with one post and the list is edited in place, so a duty is never shared between two posts. Entries are kept in the order the duties were added to the site plan. Last reviewed 2025-12-20, reference FBP-1156.
